description: Documented exemptions for the bidirectional cross-check between assessment/manifest/controls.json (a solutions[] array per control) and assessment/data/solutions-lock.json (a controls[] array per solution), enforced by scripts/validate_solutions_lock.py. Direction 'manifest-only' means the manifest asserts an association the lock does not back; direction 'lock-only' means the lock declares an association the manifest does not record. Every entry must carry a non-empty reason. Stale entries - ones that no longer match live drift - fail CI, so this file cannot silently accumulate debt. Adding an entry here is a deliberate, reviewable act; the default expectation is that both sides agree.

exceptions.reason: Framework-side secondary mapping that predates the lock contract. The lock scopes this solution to controls 2.12 and 1.10; the framework also surfaces it under 1.23 (Step-Up Authentication for AI Agent Operations). Retained rather than deleted because solutions-lock.json is produced by FSI-AgentGov-Solutions and is not editable from this repo, so removing the association here would drop framework-side curation with no upstream record. Reported for upstream reconciliation; remove this exception once the lock either adopts or rejects the mapping.
